title: FC 2302: Definitions
officialText:
2302.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

ALCOHOL-BLENDED MOTOR FUEL.

BIODIESEL.

CERTIFIED ATTENDANT.

CNG.

DISPENSING DEVICE, OVERHEAD TYPE.

FLAMMABLE LIQUID MOTOR FUEL.

FLEET MOTOR FUEL-DISPENSING FACILITY.

FULL-SERVICE MOTOR FUEL-DISPENSING FACILITY.

LIQUEFIED NATURAL GAS (LNG).

LIQUID MOTOR FUEL.

LIQUID MOTOR FUEL STORAGE AND DISPENSING SYSTEM.

MOTOR VEHICLE.

REPAIR GARAGE.

SELF-SERVICE MOTOR FUEL-DISPENSING FACILITY.
